hnswlib on Windows
------------------

SCimilarity's annotation/labelled_kNN.bin is an upstream hnswlib index, and
only upstream hnswlib reads it. PyPI has no Windows wheel for hnswlib, so:

    python install_hnswlib_win.py

fetches the conda-forge build of upstream hnswlib into this interpreter. No
conda installation is needed; require.py calls it automatically. Inside a
conda environment the equivalent is:

    conda install conda-forge::hnswlib

Do NOT install chroma-hnswlib. It is the only prebuilt Windows package using
the hnswlib import name, but it is a fork with a different file format -- it
stores one float per element between the level-0 block and the link lists, so
it reads an upstream index four bytes per element out of step and reports
"Index seems to be corrupted or unsupported".

The other route is to let pip compile hnswlib, which needs a C++ toolchain:

    winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools --override ^
        "--wait --quiet --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --includeRecommended"
    pip install hnswlib


Other notes
-----------

scimilarity pins zarr<3, which would downgrade zarr for everything else
sharing the interpreter. Nothing on the annotation path imports zarr (it is
used only by the training data models), so require.py installs scimilarity
with --no-deps and names its real dependencies itself.

tiledb-vector-search ships its own tiledb.dll in tiledb/vector_search/lib but
never puts that folder on the DLL search path. CellAnnotation imports it even
on the hnswlib path, so _scimilarity_env.py registers the folder first.
